facts.fact: Libya's Ministry of Labour and Rehabilitation says its integrated digital platform, supported by AI and built with Al-Nasr Information Technology, was about 30% complete on 13 April 2026.

LBY.note: The platform is the ministry's own administrative system, not a sector's public system.
No AI model, dataset or computing built in the country is stated.
